statement_en:
Define
$$a_{n,k}:=\begin{cases}1&(n,k)=(1,1)\\n&(n,k)=(n,n)\\1-n&(n,k)=(n,n-1)\\0&\text{otherwise.}\end{cases}$$
This double sequence does not satisfy condition 3 of Proposition 2.1. Let $$x_k:=\frac{(-1)^k}{k}.$$ Then
$$\sum_{k\le n} a_{n,k}x_k = a_{n,n-1}x_{n-1}+a_{n,n}x_n = 2(-1)^n,$$
so the limit of the sum does not exist, and therefore it cannot equal the limit $0$ of $x_k$.
key_techniques: direct evaluation of the transformed sequence
callout_body: 令$$a_{n,k}:=\begin{cases}1&(n,k)=(1,1)\\n&(n,k)=(n,n)\\1-n&(n,k)=(n,n-1)\\0&\text{otherwise}\end{cases}$$这个序列可以看成一个无穷的矩阵$A$当中的元素：$$A:=\begin{pmatrix}1&0&0&\cdots\\-1&2&0&\cdots\\ 0&-2&3&\cdots \\\vdots&\vdots&\vdots&\ddots \\0&\cdots&1-n&n\\\vdots&\vdots&\vdots&\ddots \end{pmatrix}$$这样的双重序列并不满足“命题2.1”的第三个条件，因为此时$$\sum_{k\leq n}|a_{n,k}|=2\sum_{k=1}^{n} k=n(n+1)$$令$x_k:=\frac{(-1)^k}{k}$那么$$\sum_{k\leq n} a_{n,k}x_k = a_{n,n-1}x_{n-1}+a_{n,n}x_{n}=2(-1)^n$$这个和的极限不存在，更不会等于$x_k$的极限0。
